title.narrative: Empowering Safe Science: Advancing Protection, Freedom, and Trust in Scientific Research

description.narrative: The workplan aspires to strengthen Member States’ capacities in the Maghreb to protect the freedom and safety of scientists and scientific research, with attention to crisis and emergency contexts and gender equality. It will support the reinforcement of national frameworks and institutional mechanisms, while enhancing public awareness and stakeholder engagement on science freedom, safety, and research integrity. Key activities include online assessment of capacity-building needs, policy and framework assessments, awareness-raising initiatives, and regional exchanges of good practices on safeguarding scientists, including in emergencies. As a result, national capacities and preparedness framework will be developed taping on gender-responsive approaches better integrated, and public and institutional engagement on protecting scientific freedom and research integrity significantly enhanced.
